global-counts: SELECT now() AS captured_at,COUNT(*) AS upcoming,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lineup_items l WHERE l.show_id=s.id)) AS empty_raw,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lineup_items l JOIN comedians p ON p.uuid=l.comedian_id WHERE l.show_id=s.id AND p.visible)) AS empty_visible FROM shows s WHERE s.date>now()
cohort: SELECT c.id AS club_id,c.name AS club_name,c.visible AS club_visible,s.id,s.name,s.date,s.show_page_url,s.last_scraped_date,s.last_scraped_by,s.tickets_sold_out,s.description,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('uuid',p.uuid,'name',p.name,'visible',p.visible,'parent_id',p.parent_comedian_id,'nonpublic_tag',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tagged_comedians tc JOIN tags t ON t.id=tc.tag_id WHERE tc.comedian_id=p.uuid AND NOT t.user_facing))) FROM lineup_items l JOIN comedians p ON p.uuid=l.comedian_id WHERE l.show_id=s.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS lineup FROM shows s JOIN clubs c ON c.id=s.club_id WHERE s.date>now() AND s.club_id IN(6,7,18,187) ORDER BY s.club_id,s.date,s.id
sources: SELECT c.id AS club_id,c.name,ss.* FROM clubs c JOIN scraping_sources ss ON ss.club_id=c.id WHERE c.id IN(6,7,18,187) ORDER BY c.id,ss.id
recent-runs: SELECT * FROM (SELECT club_id,run_id,num_shows,success,error_message,http_status,bot_block_detected,created_at,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY club_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM scraper_run_clubs WHERE club_id IN(6,7,18,187)) r WHERE rn<=3 ORDER BY club_id,rn
